provenance.source: OpenSCQ30 device faker recording for the Soundcore R50i NC (A3959)
provenance.kind: RECORDED HARDWARE STATE RESPONSE (device -> host 01:01 body), not a reconstruction
notes: 91-byte payload; the upstream file labels every trailing field with inline comments.

Serial bytes 16..31 were replaced with 0x58 ('X') in this copy: a device serial is a personal identifier. Offsets, length and every other byte are unchanged; nothing in this fixture depends on the serial.

Byte 69 (the read-only adaptive-sensitivity byte) is 0xFF on this recording. That is the protocol's unknown/unset marker, outside the documented 0..10 control range, and it is exactly why the Phase 19 validator refused a real device state.
